# Voxdara v0.9.7-alpha.1

Windows x64 preview of Voxdara, a local-first desktop dictation application.

- Distributed as an NSIS installer.
- This preview is unsigned. Windows SmartScreen may show an Unknown publisher warning.
- Automatic updating is disabled for this preview. Download new releases manually.
- A SHA-256 checksum is supplied alongside the installer.

Voxdara currently retains the inherited `com.pais.handy` identifier for persisted application data. Running upstream Handy and Voxdara side by side is not yet a supported isolation scenario.

Voxdara is based on [Handy by CJ Pais](https://github.com/cjpais/Handy) under the existing project license and attribution.
